newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai baht firmer, resistance seen at about 30/dlr.
newsitem.headline: Thai baht firmer, resistance seen at about 30/dlr.

text.p: The Thai baht firmed slightly in early trade in the ofshore market on Wednesday, after dipping briefly, and hitting strong resistance at around 30 baht per dollar, dealers said.

Dealers speculated that the Bank of Thailand might have stepped into the market again to prop up the baht as it climbed from around 30.500-30.750 per dollar to 29.900/30.200 and to 29.350-29.450 later.
But trading in the onshore market was quiet with the baht easing slightly to 30.110-30.200 baht per dollar compared with 29.95-29.97 baht to the dollar late on Tuesday.
Dealers saw further downward pressure on the baht as the greenback firmed against majors. The central bank announced the reference average trading rate at 29.967 baht per dollar.
The overnight interbank rate was steady at 19.00-20.00 percent as some commercial banks with ample liquidity were reluctant to lend to the market.
